fees.annual_fee_waiver: The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹3.5 lakh or more in a year on your card, as per bank policy.

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 3.5% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currencyExamples (3.5%):₹100 → ₹3.5₹1,000 → ₹35₹10,000 → ₹350₹1,00,000 → ₹3,500
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: 2.5% of the withdrawn amount is charged on cash advances using the credit card minimum ₹500, if applicable
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: A surcharge of 1% is applied to transactions made for booking railway tickets
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: Additional INR 100 on missing payment of Minimum Amount Due by due date for two consecutive cycles; applicable every cycle until MAD is cleared.

rewards.redemption_options: This is a cashback card; the cashback value is adjusted in your monthly statement.
